##load packages
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = FALSE, fig.show='hide'}
library(tidyverse) #for everything

library(cowplot) #for combining plots

#for bayesian modelling and interpreting:
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(emmeans)
library(tidybayes)
library(modelr)

```


#load data: 
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = FALSE}
behav_dat_w_site<-read.csv("../data/behav_w_site_dat.csv")
behav_dat_w_site


behav_dat_w_site_c2<-
  behav_dat_w_site%>%
  mutate(N15_c = base::scale(N15, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
          mean_atri_biomass_c = base::scale(mean_atri_biomass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
           mean_predator_biomass_c = base::scale(mean_predator_biomass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         mean_damsel_biomass_c = base::scale(mean_predator_biomass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c = base::scale(mean_turf_obs_adjusted, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         mean_structure_c =  base::scale(mean_structure, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         mean_seabird_n_input_c =  base::scale(mean_seabird_n_input, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
        size_c =  base::scale(Size, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
      mean_hsi_c =  base::scale(hsi, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
        mean_growth_c =  base::scale(growth_resid, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) )%>%
  mutate(log_total_bites_per_minute = log(total_bites_per_minute))

#add distance
behav_dat_w_site_c2_dist<-
  behav_dat_w_site_c2%>%
  mutate(sum_dist_foray_min_plus1 = sum_distance_between_forays_per_minute+1,
         mean_dist_foray_min_plus1 = mean_distance_between_forays+1,
         distance_end_start = as.numeric(Distance_end_start_m_formatted),
        distance_end_start_plus1 = distance_end_start+1 )

#add forays
behav_dat_w_site_c2_foray<-
  behav_dat_w_site_c2%>%
  mutate(forays_per_minute = number_forays/(total_time_seconds_numeric/60))

```


#(2-3) biomass->behaviour
#{ atri_dem, n15, predators, structure, turf_cover }
```{r}
###Run models TOTAL BITES--------
total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt <-
  brm(total_bites_per_minute ~mean_growth_c+ N15_c + mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c + mean_atri_biomass_c + mean_predator_biomass_c + mean_structure_c + (1|site),
                data=behav_dat_w_site_c2, family = lognormal(),
              iter = 3000, warmup = 1000, cores=4, chains = 4, 
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth=15), 
                file = "../outputs/brms/total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt") #worked
print(total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt)

plot(total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt, ask = FALSE)
pp_check(total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt)
#looks good

hypothesis(total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt, "mean_atri_biomass_c<0") #0.41 - so no effect

total_bites_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt%>%
  spread_draws(b_mean_atri_biomass_c)%>%
  median_hdci(exp(b_mean_atri_biomass_c))
#1.02  0.513   1.58

sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt <-
  brm(sum_dist_foray_min_plus1 ~mean_growth_c+ N15_c + mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c + mean_atri_biomass_c + mean_predator_biomass_c + mean_structure_c  + (1|site),
                data=behav_dat_w_site_c2_dist, family = lognormal(),
              iter = 3000, warmup = 1000, cores=4, chains = 4, 
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth=15), 
                file = "../outputs/brms/sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt") #worked
print(sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt)

plot(sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt, ask = FALSE)
pp_check(sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt)
#looks good

hypothesis(sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt, "mean_atri_biomass_c<0") #0.68 - so not much effect...large uncertainty intervals
sum_dist_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt%>%
  spread_draws(b_mean_atri_biomass_c)%>%
  median_hdci(exp(b_mean_atri_biomass_c))
# 0.958  0.488   1.42


foray_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt <-

                data=behav_dat_w_site_c2_foray, family = lognormal(),
              iter = 3000, warmup = 1000, cores=4, chains = 4, 
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth=15), 
                file = "../outputs/brms/foray_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt") #worked

foray_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt%>%

#1.00  0.520   1.50 

mean_dist_foray_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt <-
  brm(mean_dist_foray_min_plus1 ~mean_growth_c+ N15_c + mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c + mean_atri_biomass_c + mean_predator_biomass_c + mean_structure_c  + (1|site),
                data=behav_dat_w_site_c2_dist, family = lognormal(),
              iter = 3000, warmup = 1000, cores=4, chains = 4, 
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth=15),

mean_bites_foray_biomass_mod_site_loglink_alt <-
```

##----surgeonfish demographics----
#load data:
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = FALSE, fig.show='hide'}
dem_dat_w_site<-read.csv("../data/dem_w_site_dat.csv")
dem_dat_w_site


dem_dat_w_site%>%
  group_by(site)%>%
  summarize(n_hsi = length(HSI),
            n_growth = length(Growth_residuals))


#center----
dem_dat_w_site_c<-
  dem_dat_w_site%>%
  ungroup()%>%
      mutate(log_HSI = log(HSI),
             log_wave_energy_manual = log(wave_energy_manual),
             mean_seabird_n_input_c = base::scale(mean_seabird_n_input, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
       Muscle_N15_c = base::scale(Muscle_N15, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
          mean_atri_biomass_c = base::scale(mean_atri_biomass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
           mean_predator_biomass_c = base::scale(mean_predator_biomass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
          mean_damsel_biomass_c = base::scale(mean_damsel_biomass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c = base::scale(mean_turf_obs_adjusted, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         mean_structure_c =  base::scale(mean_structure, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         wave_c = base::scale(wave_energy_manual, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
         log_wave_c = base::scale(log_wave_energy_manual, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
       bites_per_minute_c = base::scale(bites_per_minute, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
       distance_per_minute_c = base::scale(distance_per_minute, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))

```




###(1) turf --> demographics
##{ atri_bio, n15, damsel_bio, structure}
```{r, message = FALSE}
###total effect wtih lognormal family :
mod_hsi_n15_turf_alt <- brm(HSI  ~ mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c+Muscle_N15_c + mean_atri_biomass_c + mean_damsel_biomass_c + mean_structure_c  + (1|site),
                data=dem_dat_w_site_c,family = lognormal(),
              iter = 3000, warmup = 1000, cores=4, chains = 4, 
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth=15), 
                file = "../outputs/brms/mod_hsi_n15_turf_alt") #worked
print(mod_hsi_n15_turf_alt)

plot(mod_hsi_n15_turf_alt, ask = FALSE)
pp_check(mod_hsi_n15_turf_alt) #looks good

mod_hsi_n15_turf_alt%>%
  spread_draws(b_mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c)%>%
  median_hdi(exp(b_mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c))
#1.009674	0.9319832	1.086405


#growth
mod_growth_turf_alt <- brm(Growth_residuals  ~ mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c+Muscle_N15_c + mean_atri_biomass_c + mean_damsel_biomass_c + mean_structure_c + (1|site),
                data=dem_dat_w_site_c,
              iter = 3000, warmup = 1000, cores=4, chains = 4, 
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth=15), 
                file = "../outputs/brms/mod_growth_turf_alt") #worked
print(mod_growth_turf_alt)

plot(mod_growth_turf_alt, ask = FALSE)
pp_check(mod_growth_turf_alt) #looks good


mod_growth_turf_alt%>%
  spread_draws(b_mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c)%>%
  median_hdi(b_mean_turf_obs_adjusted_c)
#0.002268014	-0.001567646	0.007048902

```
